name: Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — 2 Intermediate — Call Down the Hunter's Moon

system.description:
This power grants its wielder a sense of the most auspicious moment to perform a given act — a sorcerous cousin to the astrological reckonings practiced across the Almohad world and Taugast alike. The sorcerer is free to ignore the omen, but her odds of success rise sharply if she heeds it.

System: The sorcerer names the act in question aloud. On a successful challenge, she learns the best night within the next season (or the best hour before the coming dawn, for an urgent task) to attempt it. If she does act at the appointed time, she gains a number of temporary Willpower Traits (tracked separately, and lost if unused by the end of the attempt) equal to her margin of success; this power cannot be used twice for the same task. A small group of associates — no more than the sorcerer's Leadership rating — may share in the boon if each gives up a Blood Trait, which is destroyed when the power resolves. A botch produces a false omen that lures the sorcerer into acting under inauspicious stars.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
system.duration: One night or until the task is attempted
